literal_legacy_flat_cache_capacity.limits: Capacity-only lower bound; not a selected physical implementation. Excludes frame epochs/masks, gather/reduction file, scalar read port multiplicity, ECC/control protection, macro halo, PG/gutters, controllers, relays and pin/clock corridors. The old32-bank behavioral array is not a native8-bank source.

compact_window_concept.source_selection: OPEN, requires real descriptor contract, native measured response RTT, true watermark and production replay before RTL selection
compact_window_concept.physical_read_return: A centralized512bit-row cache does not prove16 geographically separated lane return paths at original1edge latency. Stride/broadcast/gather and per-lane/sector transposition must be source exact.
compact_window_concept.ABI: Native VMbank index issector[2:0], arithmetic lane isJ0..15. No N8 alias or multiplication of lane groups.

watermark_source_distinction: Original shared local-frame cr_seq/cr_cnt guarantees fully local writes and allows frame forwarding. SFU cache reads from native VM must use producer committed-write frontier or a real source-bound forwarding path; compute cr_cnt alone does not prove VM ACK/RAW readiness.
die_scope: Compare against exact die-owner SW usable polygon, not gross2016.144×1095.12 rectangle. Macro area/shape cannot be silently omitted from36-child packing. No larger-envelope grant or cache-master selection inferred.
